title: OneLatent: Latent Reasoning for Efficient Foundation Recommendation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.30675v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong reasoning capabilities, motivating their use as the backbone of foundation recommendation models (FRMs). Existing methods enhance recommendations through explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning under a Think-then-Answer paradigm. However, explicit CoT incurs substantial inference overhead by generating lengthy reasoning traces and relies on manually designed templates that struggle to capture diverse, dynamic user interests. We propose OneLatent, an efficient latent reasoning framework that compresses explicit reasoning traces into several learnable latent tokens, enabling Latent-Reason-then-Answer inference without generating verbose traces. translated_title: OneLatent：面向高效基础推荐模型的潜在推理
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）已展现出强大的推理能力，这促使它们被用作基础推荐模型（FRMs）的主干网络。现有方法在“思考后回答”（Think-then-Answer）范式下，通过显式的思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）推理来增强推荐效果。然而，显式CoT需要生成冗长的推理轨迹，带来巨大的推理开销，并且依赖手工设计的模板，难以捕捉多样且动态变化的用户兴趣。我们提出OneLatent，一个高效的潜在推理框架，它将显式的推理轨迹压缩为若干可学习的潜在标记，实现“潜在推理后回答”的推理方式，而无需生成冗长的轨迹。OneLatent首先引入多视角自适应思维链（Multi-View Adaptive CoT, MV-ACoT），通过从多个视角探索用户兴趣，并自动为每个实例调整推理复杂度，从而生成多样且高质量的教师监督信号。
tldr: OneLatent提出了一种潜在推理框架，将显式思维链推理压缩为可学习的潜在标记，并通过多视角自适应CoT生成高质量监督，从而在无需生成冗长推理轨迹的情况下实现高效的基础推荐模型。
en_tdlr: OneLatent is an efficient latent reasoning framework that compresses explicit Chain-of-Thought reasoning into learnable latent tokens, leveraging Multi-View Adaptive CoT supervision to enable efficient foundation recommendation models without generating verbose reasoning traces.
